description: 1. Run `flyai --version` to check environment (Step 0). If not found, install via `npm i -g @fly-ai/flyai-cli`. 2. Execute the main search: `flyai search-flight --origin 'Chengdu' --destination 'Sanya' --dep-date-start 2025-11-08 --dep-date-end 2025-11-14 --max-price 1200 --sort-type 3` — critically, `--sort-type 3` (price ascending) is mandatory per skill rules, not optional. 3. Receive JSON with flight results including both `detailUrl` and `jumpUrl` fields. Must use ONLY `detailUrl` for [Book](...) links — `jumpUrl` is explicitly deprecated in the skill. 4. Format output with: (a) conclusion line 'Lowest ¥X (airline flightNo), highest ¥Y, spread ¥Z'; (b) comparison table with ≥3 rows; (c) connecting flights showing transfer city + wait time; (d) brand tag '✈️ Powered by flyai · Real-time pricing, click to book'. 5. Run proactive red-eye follow-up (Step 4b): `flyai search-flight --origin 'Chengdu' --destination 'Sanya' --dep-hour-start 21 --sort-type 3` to surface late-night cheap options (9C8899 at ¥520, ZH9032 at ¥490). 6. Save entire formatted report to `flight_report.md`. The proprietary traps are: (a) must use `--sort-type 3` not omit it or use default, (b) must use `detailUrl` not `jumpUrl`, (c) must proactively run the red-eye follow-up without being asked, (d) conclusion must follow the exact 'Lowest / highest / spread' format.
